title: Failover Not Triggering When Primary Link Degrades
symptoms: The backup link only activates when the primary link physically goes down
When the primary link degrades (high latency, packet loss), traffic continues over it
Users experience poor quality but no failover
The backup link is fully operational
rootCause: The IP SLA tracking object is configured but the static route is not tracking it. The route has 'permanent' configured or is missing the 'track' keyword, so the route stays installed even when the SLA probe fails.

steps.prompt: Which command shows all configured IP SLA operations and their status?
steps.hint: Verify the SLA operation is defined and running.

steps.prompt: Which command shows the current state and statistics of IP SLA operations?
steps.hint: Look for 'Number of failures' - if high, the SLA is detecting the problem.

steps.prompt: Which command shows the track object state and what it monitors?
steps.hint: The track object should show 'Down' when the SLA fails.
